description: Java class 'ByConditionFinder' that extends 'ListFinder' to find entity values based on conditions, parsing XML elements to build query conditions.

classes.name: ByConditionFinder
classes.description: A class that finds entities based on conditions parsed from XML elements, supporting 'where' and 'having' conditions.

methods.name: getWhereEntityCondition
methods.description: Creates an EntityCondition for the 'where' clause based on the parsed condition.

methods.name: getHavingEntityCondition
methods.description: Creates an EntityCondition for the 'having' clause based on the parsed condition.
